## Why it matters

SPIEGEL's archive search covers the magazine archive from 1947 onward alongside SPIEGEL.de content from 1999 and related topic pages.

For contemporary German history, it provides a practical way to trace reporting, commentary, and changing public framing across decades of a major news outlet.
